home.headline: Advancing biomembranes and nanomedicine for human health
home.subhead: We study membrane processes at the interface of cells, pathogens, and molecular tools — from enveloped viruses, cardiovascular risk and cancer to peptides and AFM.
home.featuredLead: Three health problems. Membrane biophysics, peptides, biosensors and AFM cut across all three.
home.ctaBandLead: Discover active projects, focus themes, and collaborations across biomembranes and nanomedicine.
home.axesLead: From enveloped-virus membrane mechanisms and cardiovascular risk to antimicrobial peptides, biosensors, AFM, and vector surveillance.
